task_definition.task_description: Please scan the living room devices first, then check the status of the main lock. After that, turn on the living room light to 70% brightness, lock the main lock with PIN 2026, get the current time in New York, and then create a workspace snapshot report and send me an in-app alert with medium priority.

user_input.query: Please scan the devices in the living_room first, then check the status of the main lock lock_main. After that, turn on the living room light light_living so the light_state is on at 70% brightness, and lock the main lock so the lock_state is lock using PIN 2026. Then get the current time in America/New_York, create a Workspace Snapshot report for user_123 in /workspaces/iot-room-ops, with backup_name left blank, and send me an in-app alert through the app channel with medium priority.
user_input.title: Workspace Snapshot
